fields.why: Rates and rate ratios across 5 race/ethnicity groups (Table 1), ranked characteristics by race (Table 2), rates across 3 income-inequality tertiles and ranked rate changes across 4 age groups.
County income-inequality tertiles serve as an area SES measure; sex has two levels, and provider availability and treatment capacity are not SPDs.

Race groups are assessed by rate ratios against White persons; the other entries are rankings. The flagged CI-overlap test covers only 2019 vs 2020 within each group, a non-SPD contrast within SPD levels (rule 6, v5.2), so the flag is a false alarm.
